newsitem.title: HONG KONG: US hails China chicken talks, ban likely off.
newsitem.headline: US hails China chicken talks, ban likely off.

text.p: Talks aimed at averting a Chinese ban on imports of U.S. poultry have been hailed as a success by U.S. officials, who said Friday they expected the issue to vanish without any disruption to a major market.
A Chinese ban on imports of poultry and poultry products from 10 U.S. states, worth nearly $500 million a year, was now unlikely to be implemented, U.S. sources said.
"I'm optimistic that the issue has been resolved," a U.S. diplomat in Beijing said by telephone.
"Hopefully, this thing will now be dropped. I'm not expecting any correspondence or a list -- sometimes no news is good news," he said, speaking on condition of anonymity.
"We are hopeful this issue has been resolved," said Ray Miyamoto, the area director of the U.S. inspection service in Beijing. "We feel their primary concerns were adequately addressed."
Chinese officials were not immediately available for comment.
